method: Reconstructed after the fact, not recorded at run time. Each campaign is a uniquely-named profile introduced by exactly one commit; the configs-<profile>/ files were written locally by gen_configs.py on the same clock as git commit, so their mtimes anchor the campaign to that commit. Corroborated where possible by config content, run.log feature fingerprints, and EXPERIMENTS.md prose.

profile_commit.subject: feat: add the well-separation / output-assumption experiment profile

profile_commit_evidence: Two-minute delta, runs begin 21 minutes later. Independently corroborated by binary fingerprint: this is the first campaign whose run.log filter report contains a not-well-separated row, emitted only by dae6a74.
binary_commit_note: Not inferable. Binaries on av2/av3 lag main by an unbounded, undocumented amount, so a commit falling inside a run window may be absent from the binary that ran. 62bbc6f is the standing proof: committed 2026-07-20 14:16, squarely inside the muc run window, yet EXPERIMENTS.md records it as not in that campaign's binary. Do not derive binary attribution from window containment. Campaigns run after the --version change carry a recorded binary commit in their manifest instead.

run_window.note: Run-window mtimes come from two hosts with unsynced clocks; av3 runs ~17 min fast. Seeds partition by host (av2 low, av3 high), so the run dir name identifies which clock a timestamp came from.

caveats: Not single-revision: the run configuration changed 45 minutes into the campaign (6f0dfbe).

vendored_scripts.note: Verbatim copies of the campaign's driver scripts, recovered from git history so the directory reproduces without it. Each file records the commit it came from and its git blob sha; verify with `git hash-object <file>`. A file whose basis is `profile_commit` inherits that commit's confidence and is an attribution, not a record: the anchor dates the campaign's configs, and a long campaign could have been resumed under a later revision. Files with any other basis are pinned by campaign content, which is the stronger evidence and overrides profile_commit where the two disagree. Where reachable_from_main is false the source commit is off an unmerged branch and is not an ancestor of main; those commits are held reachable by the annotated tag `provenance/tlsf-branch`, which has to be pushed for the sha to resolve in a fresh clone. Without that tag they are dangling objects that gc will collect, and the copy here becomes the only durable instance of the content.

run_experiments.py.basis: Not the profile commit. Two revisions land between profile_commit 92073573 and the end of the run, and campaign content picks out the later one. The per-host CSVs cover seeds 0-159 (av2) and 160-319 (av3), which is f64507ca's 320-seed split; 92073573 had 160 seeds split 0-79/80-159. All 11 lift timeouts sit at 600s and none at 180s, which is 6f0dfbe's raised cap. The run opened 8 minutes after f64507ca and 6f0dfbe landed 45 minutes in (recorded in caveats), so the first 45 minutes ran under f64507ca, which differs only in the lift timeout cap.
